chosenApproach: Separate download admission from display acknowledgement; notify mounted Android tiles when a fullscreen original paints using the same Expo cache key; ignore stale callbacks and renew failed signed URLs.
selectionRationale: Preserves existing post layout and private media pipeline. Current mounted overlays only inspect disk on initial attempt, so later fullscreen downloads cannot wake a queued tile. Current decode also retains download capacity until onDisplay.
alternativeApproaches: Remove concurrency gate entirely: rejected because weak-network bandwidth and memory remain bounded requirements.
Rewrite shared post rendering: rejected because user confirms that rendering is correct outside production APK.
Periodic cache polling: rejected in favor of a transient path-specific completion event without retained media URLs.
